text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
That concludes your morning official duties.
There's a break before your next engagement—what would you like to do?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that true? In that case...
I think I'll go for a short walk.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. It suddenly feels
just a little too quiet.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be because the days I spent running
with everyone were so lively and fulfilling?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Those days were my youth. Researching what
I love most together with my friends—
a time fleeting and brilliant, like fireworks.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(It's sad to think that, little by little...
even if just by fractions, it will eventually weather away.)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Huh?
This smell is...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp. Sluuuurp!*
Mmm! It's so good!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪ I can't help but smile. I had no idea a shop like this opened up around here too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Ramen really is the best!
With every bite, the savory flavor just bursts out—)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on in, come one, come all!
Get your delicious, piping-hot soy sauce ramen right here~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Even so, I still wanted to do my best...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This is our way of repaying you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ Ah, I see.
There was no need for reluctant farewells at all—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Fufu! It's been so long since I ate this after those days came to an end, but... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: There is no need to feel lonely.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure we will never forget these days
we spent giving back, accomplishing it all together.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Because, every time I eat ramen, I remember.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Stimulated by the aroma, stimulated by the taste.
The whole journey I walked with everyone!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Traveling all over the country, working hard on my warrior training. Making delicious ramen—and not-so-delicious ramen—all for the sake of the ultimate bowl.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Above all, bringing smiles to our fans
—with our ramen.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter how distant those memories become.
I... no, all of us will!

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Fine
text_block_list.text: I will never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was working off-site today,
and before I knew it, it had gotten quite late into the night.
choice_data_list: If I go home and cook now... that'd be too late, huh?
If I go home and cook now... that'd be too late, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was thinking about grabbing whatever at an eatery
along the way home, an appetizing aroma drifted over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All other options lingering in my mind vanished.
Well then. To give it my all tomorrow too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Maybe I'll have ramen today."
